propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https (http://) Jira URLs without validation, risking credential exposure in cleartext transit.
DC's ReconcilerConfig rejects non-https base_url via _validate_reconciler_tls unless reconciler.allow_insecure=true, but Cloud's JiraConfig has no equivalent __post_init__ validation.
JiraConfig must add allow_insecure bool field and __post_init__ calling a shared _validate_https_url validator that raises InsecureUrlError naming the cleartext risk and override key.

write_jira_config must fail-loud (validate https-only before persist) to prevent the onboarding wizard from silently writing a cleartext URL; resolve_jira_settings must re-raise InsecureUrlError before degrading to env fallback.
resolve_jira_datacenter_settings must propagate InsecureUrlError (no change needed; already fail-loud), providing parity with DC's reject posture.
